# Pallume

> Pallume builds custom AI accountability systems for business owners.
Each system is configured from a 60–75 minute deep-dive interview, runs
inside the client's own Claude account every morning, and is reviewed
weekly by the coach. Not a template. Not an app. An operational system
built around how you specifically work.

- [Homepage](https://pallume.com/): What Pallume is and who it's for
- [How It Works](https://pallume.com/how-it-works): The three-stage
  engagement process (Build → Deploy → Refine)
- [Pricing](https://pallume.com/pricing): Path A ($1,000/month
  individual), Path B ($1,500/month teams), Path C (custom)
- [About Camden Bennett](https://pallume.com/about): Founder background

- [Apply](https://pallume.com/apply): Nine-question application reviewed
  personally by Camden
- [Pallume Journal Lite](https://pallume.com/pallume-light): Free 14-day
  structured journaling experience

## About the Founder

Camden Bennett founded Pallume after 15 years in the U.S. Navy (Diver,
then Intelligence Officer) and a return to Wyoming as managing broker of
the top-producing real estate brokerage in Sublette County. He runs the
same system he builds for every client.
Contact: [camden@pallume.com](mailto:camden@pallume.com). Location: Pinedale, Wyoming.

## Engagement Details

- Path A — Individual: $1,000/month. Solo operators, executives,
  business owners.
- Path B — Organizational: $1,500/month. Teams up to 3 people.
- Path C — Custom: Scoped individually.
- Minimum commitment: 2 months. Recommended baseline: 3 months.
- Client owns their system and their Claude account. No lock-in.
